Travel Itinerary Day Planner

Plan a multi-day trip hour by hour: add days, drop in timed activities, reorder freely — auto-saved in your browser with a printable itinerary.

Auto-saves as you type.

📖 How to use

  1. Press Add day to create Day 1, Day 2, and so on.
  2. Inside a day, add activities with a start time and description.
  3. Remove any activity or whole day you no longer need — everything auto-saves.
  4. Press Print itinerary for a clean paper copy of the whole trip.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Where is my itinerary stored?

In your browser's localStorage, namespaced to this tool. It persists across reloads on the same browser and device.

Can I add times like 09:30?

Yes — each activity has a time field (HH:MM) and a free-text description for what, where and notes.

How do I share the itinerary?

Use Copy as text to get a plain-text version for messaging apps, or Print for paper/PDF.
